command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77
LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
echo '=== AVATAR PARALLAX / GATE0 PROVENANCE AUDIT ==='
date -Is
echo '--- LIVE SOURCE INVARIANT ---'
sha256sum "$LIVE/buehne.html" "$LIVE/buehne_daemon.py"
echo '--- DISCOVERED RIG/PARALLAX DIRS ---'
find /home/ai-core-node -maxdepth 5 -type d \( -iname '*parallax*' -o -iname 'FRANK_AVATAR_RIG_V2' -o -iname 'rig2' -o -iname '*avatar*rig*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -120
echo '--- LIVE PARALLAX FILES ---'
if [ -d "$LIVE/kopf_rgba_parallax" ]; then find "$LIVE/kopf_rgba_parallax" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%P\t%s\t%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' | sort; else echo LIVE_PARALLAX_DIR=MISSING; fi
echo '--- IMAGE METROLOGY ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import hashlib, json
root=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/kopf_rgba_parallax')
rows=[]
if root.exists():
  for p in sorted(root.rglob('*.png')):
    with Image.open(p) as im:
      im.load(); alpha=im.getchannel('A') if 'A' in im.getbands() else None
      bbox=alpha.getbbox() if alpha else None
      rows.append({'file':str(p.relative_to(root)),'size':im.size,'mode':im.mode,'alpha_bbox':bbox,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('PARALLAX_IMAGE_COUNT='+str(len(rows)))
print('DIMENSION_SET='+json.dumps(sorted({tuple(r['size']) for r in rows})))
print('UNIQUE_SHA_COUNT='+str(len({r['sha256'] for r in rows})))
PY
echo '--- REFERENCES / PROVENANCE TEXT ---'
grep -RIn --exclude='*.png' --exclude='*.jpg' --exclude='*.webp' -E 'kopf_rgba_parallax|parallax|head_neck_anchor|neck_anchor|Gate.?0|GATE.?0' "$LIVE" 2>/dev/null | head -240 || true
echo '--- CANDIDATE MANIFESTS / BUILD SCRIPTS ---'
find /home/ai-core-node -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -iname '*manifest*.json' -o -iname '*manifest*.md' -o -iname 'build_rig_v2.py' -o -iname '*parallax*.json' -o -iname '*parallax*.md' -o -iname '*parallax*.py' -o -iname '*gate*0*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -200
echo '--- LIVE SOURCE PARALLAX USE ---'
grep -nE 'kopf_rgba_parallax|parallax' "$LIVE/buehne.html" || true
echo '=== AUDIT COMPLETE: READ_ONLY ==='
